quotes.text: Piero [Hincapie] is evolving really well… Zubi [Martin Zubimendi] looks much better and we have another session tomorrow. After that, we will assess whether he’s available for Forest.
It’s getting better. We are looking forward to having Amine [Adli] and Justin [Kluivert] back in the squad tomorrow.
Jannik [Schuster] and Kev [Kevin Schade] have been on the grass this week and we’ll see what tomorrow brings in terms of how much they can do.
We can expect him [Jack Hinshelwood] to return… He [Pascal Struijk] gets another day of recovery and we will see how he is tomorrow and then we make a decision.
We don’t set timelines but he [Reece James] will be out for several weeks. It won’t be short.
Josh [Eccles] is not yet – he had a baby girl last week. He’s got a little bit of an issue with his ankle… And Woolfenden is a little bit longer than that.
JP Mateta will not be here tomorrow. Dean Henderson, Takehiro Tomiyasu, Ben Chilwell too.
Mykolenko is doing much better, he’s got a chance for the game and Christian [Norgaard] has still got a wee bit to go…
We have a small problem with Hugo [Larsson] – his groin. We will check today, but I’m not sure if he will be okay for tomorrow. Everyone else is available.
Mendy is out of this game because he felt his groin, so he will be out for two weeks.
Joe [Rodon] will still miss this game on week seven so edging closer…
It’s early for us to say, we have still tomorrow’s training… I leave the chance open this time, yes.
And we’ll see for tomorrow, he’s [Phil Foden] available but we have so many games that we’ll decide if he’s going to start or not.
We’ll see on Luke [Shaw] and Kobbie [Mainoo].
Bazo [Bazoumana Traore] seems to be much better, we’re happy for that… Hopefully next week he [Anthony Elanga] is about to train again…
Morgan Gibbs-White is a doubt. He couldn’t train the entire week with us. It looks like he can join tomorrow’s session.
Brian [Brobbey] travelled with the squad, as did Habib [Diarra], so they will be involved quickly, but we need to respect the process.
